## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made, the motivation behind them, and any relevant context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX refinement

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds locally without any TypeScript or Vite compile errors.
- [ ] No extraneous console logs, debugging artifacts, or secrets are committed.
- [ ] Changes do not degrade canvas 60fps rendering performance.
